articles.summary: Abstract This paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of GitHub Copilot’s deployment and impact on developer productivity at Zoominfo, a leading Go-To-Market (GTM) Intelligence Platform. We describe our systematic four-phase approach to evaluating and deploying GitHub Copilot across our engineering organization, involving over 400 developers. Our analysis combines both quantitative metrics,…
articles.title: Experience with GitHub Copilot for Developer Productivity at Zoominfo
